I've been planting cotton on these 5 mu for many years now. Let me think through this year like I always do — start from what I did last year, then decide if I need to change anything.

**Seed:** I always buy the Bt cotton seed (抗虫棉) from the dealer in town. The old varieties without Bt get eaten alive by bollworm — I learned that in the 90s the hard way. I'll buy about 1.5 kg of seed per mu, a good improved hybrid variety. Cost maybe 40-50 yuan per mu for seed, but worth it.

**Land prep:** I plough deep before planting — cotton roots go deep, and the soil here packs hard if I just rotary-till every year. I'll plough once in March, then rotary-harrow before sowing in late April.

**Fertilizer:** Cotton is hungry, especially for nitrogen and potassium. Last year I used about 50 kg of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) as base fertilizer per mu, then topdressed with urea twice — once at budding, once at flowering. That works out to about 18 kg pure N per mu, 7-8 kg P, and 8 kg K. I might add a bit more potassium this year because my neighbor Old Wang said his bolls were bigger when he used extra potash. Potassium helps the bolls fill out. I'll add maybe 5 kg potassium sulfate extra per mu at flowering time.

**Irrigation:** I have the well, thank goodness. Cotton needs water at flowering and boll-filling especially. I'll water about 4 times — once after sowing if dry, once at budding, once at flowering peak, once during boll development. Quzhou doesn't get enough rain in summer reliably.

**Pesticide:** Even with Bt cotton, I still spray a lot. Bt handles bollworm mostly, but aphids, spider mites, and plant bugs (盲蝽) have gotten worse since everyone switched to Bt. I'll spray maybe 7-8 times through the season. Aphids in early season, mites and plant bugs mid-season, then a couple late sprays for cotton leafworm and late bollworm generations. Pesticide is expensive but losing bolls is worse.

**Yield expectation:** On good years I get about 250 kg seed cotton per mu. If weather cooperates and no big pest outbreak, I'm hoping for 260 this year.

5 mu is small — every yuan matters. But cotton price has been okay, so I won't cut corners on fertilizer or sprays. Better to spend the money and get the yield than save 200 yuan and lose 500 yuan of cotton.
